{{Top|leg}}
'''Imperial identification cards''' were used to identify the various beings of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. An Imperial identification card was needed to purchase items in [[Larvit's store]].

==History==
In [[3950 BBY]] when [[Meetra Surik]] came to [[Larvit]]'s [[Larvit's store|store]] to convert her [[Diamond/Legends|diamonds]] into the [[Imperial credit|local currency]] he asked her to present her Imperial identification card.<ref name="Revan">''[[The Old Republic: Revan]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Imperial identification card of the Sith Empire was first mentioned in [[Drew Karpyshyn]]'s novel ''[[The Old Republic: Revan]]'', which was released on [[November 15]], [[2011]].
